channelTitle: A boy named his doll Robert - then blamed him for everything that went wrong - Part 1
hook: This doll sits behind glass in a Florida museum, and the staff swear the apology letters addressed to him never stop coming. His name is Robert.
storyParts: Key West, around nineteen oh four - a boy named Robert Eugene Otto, everyone called him Gene, received an unusual gift: a life-sized straw doll in a little white sailor suit. He named it Robert.
Gene became oddly attached. He set a place for Robert at the table, took him to bed every night, and neighbors swore they heard two voices coming from the boy's room - one small and one low.
Then things started getting blamed on the doll. Toys found torn apart, furniture knocked over in the night - Gene's answer was always the same, delivered with a straight face: Robert did it.
Gene grew up, became an artist, and kept Robert anyway. He gave the doll its own room in the attic of the Eaton Street house, furnished it with tiny furniture, and would go up to visit him.
Neighbors said the strangest thing was the attic window - folks walking by would glance up and swear the doll had moved from one side to the other, or that his expression had changed.
cta: What happened after Gene died and the museum took Robert in - Part 2 in the playlist, and it gets stranger.
